asset_set: Questionnaire Q17 option 2 — Creating public space murals

art_style.fill_technique: solid flat fills with optional 8–12% ambient shade on curved surfaces only
art_style.shading: single cel shadow ellipse under tray and wrists — no cast shadows on transparent edge
art_style.texture: none on skin; scattered paint-fleck dots on sleeve via 4 dots max
art_style.mood: joyful expressive street-art energy — approachable public creativity, not vandalism
reference_vibe: KursoKo approved RIASEC sticker line weight
art_style.match_family: Same 2px ink and flat fill language as RIASEC stickers — but NO letter glyph and NO colored border frame
forbidden: die-cut sticker border or white card frame

accent.name: sunshine yellow
accent.use: mural sun motif, wet roller paint

secondary.name: lavender
secondary.use: mural triangle accents, paint-fleck sleeve dots

color.background: fully transparent — no floor plane, no vignette, no cream fill behind scene
color.lighting_tint: faint warm #FFF8F0 highlight on knuckle tops and wet paint
color.accent_rule: yellow appears on 2–3 small areas max — not a background wash

lighting.highlight: small curved highlight on wet roller paint and tray rim
lighting.shadow: flat #2D2D2D at 12% opacity under tray and hands

pose.camera_distance: medium-close — hands occupy lower 55% of frame

left_hand.action: guides the paint roller upward across the mural wall
left_hand.grip: full-hand grip on the roller handle

right_hand.action: holds the paint tray steady below
right_hand.grip: fingers curled under the tray lip

pose.gesture_summary: mid-stroke freeze frame — roller gliding upward across the wall
pose.framing: crop at mid-forearm — no elbows, no face, no torso

subject.scene_narrative: A pair of paint-flecked hands guides a roller upward across a mural wall bursting with bold geometric shapes and a yellow sun motif, while the other hand steadies a paint tray below. The scene reads as joyful public art in progress, not vandalism.

primary_objects.name: mural wall section
primary_objects.detail: bold geometric sun motif in yellow with lavender triangle accents, one fresh roller stroke visible

primary_objects.name: paint roller
primary_objects.material: foam roller head on wood handle
primary_objects.detail: wet yellow paint coating, minimal drips

primary_objects.name: paint fleck accents
primary_objects.detail: scattered small dots, decorative not messy

subject.environment: outdoor wall panel strip across bottom two-thirds — fades to transparent at edges, no street or crowd

composition.layout: vertical workflow line from paint tray up through roller to the mural sun motif
composition.negative_space: transparent margin top and sides — 40px safe zone for card crop
depth_layers: background: wall edge only — no street
composition.thumbnail_readability: mural sun motif + roller hand readable at 160px width

generation.negative_prompt: face, portrait, person head, text, watermark, logo, letter A, border frame, sticker outline, photorealistic, 3d render, cgi, blurry, dark background, graffiti tagging, vandalism, gang symbols, guns, blood
